column1: # FNA3D's OpenGL driver makes the GL calls of other threads on the main thread, once a frame in SwapBuffers. The game's preload threads load content under one lock, and a texture
# among it waited for a frame the main thread could not reach: it was still in LoadContent, waiting for that lock. With this row the main thread runs the driver's list when it
